description:
Move the class-level DNS cache state and rebinding-check logic out of
CrestHttpClient into its own class.

Current scope (src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr lines ~22-65, 311-396):

  @@dns_cache, @@dns_cache_lock, @@dns_max_entries, @@dns_cleanup_registered,
  @@dns_cleanup_proc, ensure_dns_cleanup_registered, dns_max_entries=,
  dns_max_entries, dns_cleanup_proc, get_cached_dns, cache_dns,
  enforce_dns_limit, clear_dns_cache (instance), clear_expired_dns,
  verify_dns_rebinding, should_check_dns_rebinding?, extract_host, valid_host?,
  validate_cached_dns, resolve_and_validate_new_dns, valid_address?,
  validate_address_for_host.

Target:

  src/fetcher/dns_cache.cr with Fetcher::DnsCache (singleton or class-methods),
  and a thin Fetcher::DnsRebindingChecker (or method on the cache) that
  encapsulates the resolve/validate/cache flow.

Specific issues to fix while moving:

  - Replace the @@dns_cache + @@dns_cache_lock + @@dns_max_entries trio with a
    proper class that owns its own state and exposes a constructor that takes
    a max_entries (so tests can size it down).
  - Replace the side-effecting ensure_dns_cleanup_registered flag with explicit
    start/stop. Add a #stop method that unregisters from PeriodicCleanup.
  - Fix the inconsistent config behaviour: cache_enabled is checked in
    get_cached_dns/cache_dns via @config.dns.cache_enabled, but the class
    methods that mutate state do not check it. Either check uniformly or
    document and enforce that the cache_enabled flag is process-wide.
  - Replace the random-eviction loop in enforce_dns_limit (current implementation
    samples keys while the cache is at capacity, which is O(infinite) when the
    size never drops - the sample-then-delete pattern only shrinks when
    @@dns_cache.size > target_size, so it can spin).
  - Replace Socket::IPAddress equality with a hash that includes port, or
    document that port-less entries are shared across ports.
  - Move valid_address?, extract_host, valid_host? into a small helper or onto
    URLValidator::Service (they are already in the validator's domain).

Test impact:

  spec/dns_cache_spec.cr currently pokes the DNS cache through debug_* helpers
  on CrestHttpClient. After this lands, those helpers should call into
  Fetcher::DnsCache. Update the spec to require ./support/dns_cache_test_helpers
  (which the uncommitted diff already references - fold that in here).
title: Extract DNS cache + rebinding into Fetcher::DnsCache
